name: Maintenance Hidden Value Driver
applicable_contexts: energy symptom visible before maintenance reality is bounded
trigger_conditions: critical production or support systems plausible
physical_basis: Weak maintenance execution can elevate load, stress assets and create repeated failures that look like pure energy issues.
operational_basis: Maintenance reality can dominate plant economics before direct utility savings do.
financial_mechanism: Downtime, scrap, failure cost and reliability erosion can outweigh straightforward efficiency logic.
typical_false_assumption: If energy cost is visible, maintenance is secondary.
hypothesis: Maintenance may be a hidden value driver that dominates economics before energy does.
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: maintenance weakness materially explains the burden
falsification_conditions: maintenance reality does not explain the visible symptom
allowed_claim_language: Maintenance may dominate economics before energy does and should be bounded as a rival explanation.
financial_exposure_if_true: CAPEX may target a secondary symptom
stop_conditions: maintenance economics are bounded enough to rank their materiality
escalation_conditions: maintenance leadership confirmation required if documentary proof remains thin
example_outputs: Maintenance may dominate economics before energy does.
tests: manufacturing acceptance bundle should admit this when maintenance proof remains unresolved
pattern must remain bounded at L2
